references.text: Describes the actual construction of the east side of the courtyard with the same measurement of fifty cubits, fulfilling the instructions given here.
Provides the context for the dimensions of the courtyard on the other sides, which together with the east side form the entire outline of the courtyard.
Summarizes the total dimensions of the courtyard, including the length of fifty cubits corresponding to the width of the east side.
Ezekiel's temple vision also describes courtyards with specific measurements, showing continuity in the design of the sanctuary.
Complementary description of the same tabernacle structure; together they show the complete geometry (100x50 cubits) of the sanctuary.
